data: NVIDIA's fiscal 2023 (the year ended January 29, 2023) was a weak year relative to the surrounding ones. Revenue was about $26.97 billion, down 0.2% from $26.91 billion in fiscal 2022. Gross profit was about $15.36 billion, which works out to a gross margin of roughly 56.9%, down from 64.9% the prior year, pressured by inventory charges of about $2.17 billion and other items. Operating income was about $4.22 billion, an operating margin of roughly 15.6%, compared with $10.04 billion and about 37.3% in fiscal 2022. Operating expenses rose to about $11.13 billion, including a $1.35 billion acquisition termination charge tied to the cancelled Arm deal. These figures are from memory of NVIDIA's reported results, so please confirm them against the fiscal 2023 Form 10-K before relying on them.
